title: Coding-agent turn trace
description: One OpenAI-compat chat turn as the sidecar sees it. Do not invent Claude Code history or cached_tokens.

id.description: Stable id for this turn (filename stem or fixture id).

source.description: live = captured request+response. synthetic-shape = structural seed, not a Claude Code dump.

tools.description: Tool definitions on the request, if any.

cached_tokens.description: Only from API usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens (or equivalent). Never invent.

thinking_tokens.description: If the provider reports reasoning/thinking tokens separately.

max_tokens.description: Request max_tokens. Used to flag capped completions and to estimate context budget.

model.description: Requested or returned model id (MoM, a Fireworks pin, or a routed alias).

routed_model.description: Physical model the sidecar or API actually used, if known.
